purpose: Prepare and measure a bounded CUDA development resource pilot before any full HPO/NAS campaign. No GPU results exist at registration.

fixed_recipe.optimizer: AdamW using common fixed betas/epsilon/loss/normalization and epoch rules
fixed_recipe.dropout_non_nas: existing dropout0.1 for TSMixer,iTransformer and neural references;0 for source CNNs
fixed_recipe.dropout_nas: solely declared architecture bits at p0.2
fixed_recipe.scope: Fixed before2023 pilot. Never reuse HPO winners from2024 or2025 and never select candidates on pilot scores. No additional HPO.

target.definition: Population sigma7 of seven daily log returns, ddof0, h1, unannualized

selection_policy: Models/cohorts/optional-largest are sealed before reading market values. Accuracy never selects execution policy or model winners.
failure_policy: Retain failed/censored attempts and consumed resources. No replacement seed, batch fallback or retry. Known steps are retained; unknown counts remain null. Unstarted jobs under total budget are not fitted and remain explicitly not_attempted_campaign_budget.
persistence_policy: Raw execution receipts stay in the chosen runtime storage. No automatic pushes, uploads, credential collection or deletion of historical outputs. Scientific exports use an explicit public-field allowlist.
budget_interpretation: 900 seconds is a campaign admission/supervisor limit with process teardown overhead, not a promised complete-pilot or full-campaign elapsed time.
